description: Put a generated email (an artifact_id from generate_email) in the user's Gmail drafts, addressed to the recipients they named. Nothing is sent. The email has to be unlocked first: a watermarked draft is refused and the user unlocks it from the card. Only works on mailboxes connected under a legacy modify grant; the tool says so if not. Returns a link to the draft.

account.description: Email address of the connected mailbox to draft in. Omit for the first one.

name: draft_email_in_gmail
title: Draft in Gmail
